The activity requests retrieval of supplier payment terms and financial commitments (accounts payable, outstanding invoices, scheduled payments). While the candidates include procurement and supply chain resources, none of them directly fulfill this financial/accounting requirement:

- The API and agent resources focus on material receipts, engineering changes, production orchestration, and asset provisioning—not financial data
- The dataProducts analyze workforce and operational capability, not supplier financials
- The Material and Vendor Master Data API retrieves specifications and vendor master records, not payment terms or accounts payable

This activity requires a financial management or accounts payable system resource that the graph walk did not surface.
